tara: quick sync after the postmortem 1: we agreed to three focused tasks: quota backstop, scheduler knob defaults, and a 1-page headroom checklist. short updates here only.

ben: ill own scheduler knobs (TASK-SCHED). plan: run a 24h replay, test preemption.deadline_ms and backfill.window_sec sweep, then open a conservative PR. draft by 2025-06-06.

sam (oncall): include a short smoke test (5 steps) that verifies preemption order + kv-cache retention. i can run a simulated surge on 2025-06-07 evening.

irene: i'll take quota backstop (TASK-QUOTA). proposal: soft per-team burst quota with 10m grace, then route to reserved pool. i will post a mapping CSV and draft card by 2025-05-31.

tara: i'll write the headroom checklist (TASK-HEAD): 1 page, contact matrix, and an alert at 10% headroom. draft by 2025-05-29.

ben: sample config i'll test in staging:
``` 
scheduler:
  preemption:
    deadline_ms: 45000
  backfill:
    window_sec: 25
```

sam (oncall): ops-bot please create a recurring 6-week check every Wed 10:00 PT and invite tara, ben, irene, sam (oncall).

ops-bot: created event "GPU surge remediation follow-up" weekly Wed 10:00 PT. invites sent. link: https://calendar.redwood/internal/evt/11678

tara: owners + deadlines recap: TASK-SCHED ben  2025-06-06; TASK-QUOTA irene  2025-05-31; TASK-HEAD tara  2025-05-29. post short progress updates to the board and tag this thread if blocked. :thumbsup:

(narrow follow-up 2025-05-26) ben: uploaded replay logs and opened PR #1253 for review.

(narrow follow-up 2025-05-27) irene: quota mapping CSV posted; @product-infra please review by 2025-05-30.

(ops-bot 2025-06-04): reminder: next weekly follow-up in 48 hours.
